tools.name: flight_price_verdict
tools.description: Answers "buy now or wait?" for a route, from 90 days of observed prices: verdict, percentile of today's cheapest fare against its own history, median, all-time low, and sample size. This is not a flight search: it judges a price. No other public source computes it, because it needs the price history

tools.name: cheapest_months
tools.description: The departure months ranked by observed median price for a route, with the median of each. Answers "when is it cheapest to go" with measured data instead of seasonal folklore.

tools.name: when_to_book
tools.description: How many days before departure this route has historically been cheapest, from our own observations. Answers "am I booking too early or too late?".

tools.name: watched_routes
tools.description: Lists the routes Piratefly observes daily and can therefore judge. Call this first, or after any answer saying a route is not watched, to find out what can be asked. Filter by origin and/or destination city (partial city name is fine) or omit both for the full list.
